packageRules.description: Bump devDependency ranges eagerly: nothing downstream consumes them, so a raised floor costs nobody anything and keeps the lockfile honest about what CI actually ran.

Never narrow what consumers can satisfy. `dependencies` keep their published range until a release falls outside it, and peer ranges only ever widen — this is a library, so a bumped floor here is a breaking change for downstreams.
Separate major updates into their own PRs; keep them off the weekly batch.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group the ESLint / typescript-eslint / prettier toolchain.
Keep temml + mathml2omml (the optional /math peer deps) in lockstep.
Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs and batch their updates.
